up: Return IC50 activity values (in nM) for compounds tested against the human SRC kinase (CHEMBL267). For each matching activity, provide: the compound's ChEMBL ID, canonical SMILES, assay description, and the provenance reference as PubMed ID or DOI (prefer PubMed ID if both are present).
sql:
SELECT
  md.chembl_id,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  a.standard_value AS ic50_nM,
  ass.description AS assay_description,
  COALESCE(d.pubmed_id, d.doi) AS pubmed_id_or_doi
FROM activities a
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id
WHERE
  td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL267'
  AND a.standard_type = 'IC50'
  AND a.standard_units = 'nM'
